claim_boundary: This is a preregistered Jin-2021-style M8 proxy, not a faithful reproduction of Jin et al. The paper does not specify a hexagonal class set, raster normalization, CNN widths, optimizer, direct-slide length, reset rule, or finite-time terminal contract. Its published square/pentagon percentages are background only and are not numerically comparable to this M8 benchmark.

comparison.improved_estimator: frozen P1v3 three-seed circular 1D CNN ensemble

requirements: byte-identical probe trace within each paired pose
same XY speed, force/admittance, noise, delay, yaw and insertion controller
same sensor-only capture handoff and strict CAD-bottom verifier
no retry, reset, or estimator-specific controller tuning

decision_rule.direction_claim: The improved estimator is more accurate only if the fresh paired direction audit has lower median angular error; p90, threshold rates, catastrophic errors, and paired uncertainty remain visible regardless of outcome.
decision_rule.task_claim: The improved fingerprint direct line has a higher success rate only if fresh paired first-ray capture and/or strict CAD-bottom improve. Direction improvement alone is not task-success improvement.
decision_rule.no_post_result_tuning: Proxy preprocessing, architecture, seeds, training split, ray controller, and test sets are frozen here before P1v6 or fresh strict outcomes are read. Any later change requires a new version and a new untouched test set.

metrics: executed angular error median and p90
within 7.5 degree and within 15 degree rates
common 12-sector top-1 accuracy for both estimators
paired base-pose bootstrap interval for angular-error difference

jin_style_proxy.classes: 12 directional sectors at 30 degree spacing; aligned class omitted because the audit is conditioned on ambiguous off-center top contact
jin_style_proxy.input: shared raw scan, using Xz/tip_z, Mx/Tx, My/Ty only
jin_style_proxy.paper_fixed_elements: 2000 phase samples, 20-sample circular moving average, 200x200 polar binary image, 3x20x20 network input, two convolution layers, two max-pooling layers, one fully connected layer
jin_style_proxy.proxy_choices_missing_from_paper: per-scan min-max radius mapping, 2-pixel closed polyline, 10x10 max downsampling, conv widths 16/32, 3x3 kernels, Adam 1e-3, early stopping
jin_style_proxy.training_data: same grouped P0b/P0d/P1v3 development data and split seed 20260710 as the improved estimator; P1v5, P1v6, strict-24, and fresh strict-48 are forbidden

reference: Jin et al., Contact Pose Identification for Peg-in-Hole Assembly under Uncertainties, 2021
